verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents a first-party cardholder disputes capability to "submit and manage debit card disputes in line with Regulation E (Reg E) and card network requirements," so card disputes are covered at least at a headline level. The evidence covers ACH returns of originated transfers only, which is a different capability from consumer ACH dispute handling. Missing for 10: Reg E investigation timeline details, provisional credit mechanics, ACH/unauthorized-debit dispute handling, documented ops-user responsibilities and tooling, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
